notes.title: Demo Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Witches & Wizards,

We're very excited to launch the Pumpkin Woods [b]Demo[/b] as part of the Hungry Ghost Festival! The new update includes many quality of life features, new content and a ton of bug fixes thanks to your valuable feedback during the playtest!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/533846f885f2781cd9f8339ba0f66be67e357a95.png"][/img]
[b]Full Changelog Version 0.2.2 (Demo)
[/b] [/p][p]- Added a new quest to tame a wild unicorn (requires healing potion)[/p][p]- Added a letter at the start of the game to establish lore[/p][p]- Added large cliffs and scenic wooden pathways to the starting biome[/p][p]- Integrated menu between inventory / craft / journal / map panels[/p][p]- Item health effects are now stackable and show on the UI[/p][p]- Tooltip system for actions completely reworked with intuitive interface[/p][p]- Dig spots now reveal a hidden chest with random loot instead of gold ore[/p][p]- Attack and use tool animations are now faster and without delay[/p][p]- Standing on fire now deals damage[/p][p]- Days have become 20% faster (48 minutes instead of 60 minutes)[/p][p]- Added visual effects for cat & unicorn taming, stay and follow actions[/p][p]- Added new map icons for tents and important landmarks[/p][p]- Wolf and unicorn behavior completely reworked with significant optimization[/p][p]- New reliable door system with better performance and audio[/p][p]- Improved pathfinding for wild animals[/p][p]- World generation process reworked for better performance at the start[/p][p]- Digging now plays a digging animation instead of attacking[/p][p]- The witch tower will no longer spawn next to the vendor[/p][p]- Witch huts had their spawn rate slightly increased[/p][p]- Sleep time multiplier increased from 36x to 48x (time passes faster)[/p][p]- Locked doors now play a warning sound that a key is required[/p][p]- Mine, catacombs, maze, temples are now limited to 1 each to increase variety[/p][p]- Reduced the negative health effects when eating pizzas[/p][p]- Upgraded the chest mesh in the old tent[/p][p]- Added controls section and return to game button in the pause menu[/p][p]- Large rocks were slightly modified to better fit the terrain[/p][p]- Shop panel now displays icon of the selected item[/p][p]- Wooden boxes are now easier to hit and destroy[/p][p]- Minor collider optimization[/p][p]- Minor UI improvements
[/p][p][b]Chill Mode Specific Changes
[/b][/p][p]- Chill mode now have wolves that don't charge the player unprovoked[/p][p]- Unicorns in chill mode no longer attack the player unprovoked
[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes
[/b][/p][p]- Fixed dialogue not starting when the player is near NPCs[/p][p]- Fixed player getting stuck in an infinite loop when using doors[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the player could spawn under a rock[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where wolves and unicorns would often get stuck[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where sometimes the player could not use tools[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where the anvil could not be placed[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the vanity table could not be used[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the shop panel would not open properly[/p][p]- Fixed UI tooltip flickering when displaying the required item[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where the cursor would recenter when opening the journal[/p][p]- Fixed clipping issues on the unicorn & horse mane and tail[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck on the campfire and firewood[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with colliders on one of the temples[/p][p]- Removed the cinematic intro due to inconsistent camera behavior[/p][p]- Minor fixes and adjustments

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/8f78ed3390464ef9af311f203ba77ae82918fda0.png"][/img]
[b]Important Note

[/b]Saves from previous versions are not compatible, please start a new world.
Demo saves won't be playable in the full game due to ongoing system upgrades. [/p][p]
Your [b]feedback[/b] is very much welcomed in the Steam discussions or Discord:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ"]https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ[/url][/p]

notes.title: Demo Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Witches & Wizards, 

We finally have the official release date for the Pumpkin Woods Demo!

  [b]   [/b]* * *[b] [i]SEPTEMBER 4TH[/i][/b] * * *

The new update will include many quality of life features, new content and a ton of bug fixes thanks to your valuable feedback during the playtest! The full changelog will be released at launch, but here is a short preview of the [b]new features[/b]:  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/57725d5236c5f44224a2a179476555af87b61e11.png"][/img][/p][p]The UI has been revamped to be simple and intuitive. Possible actions are now displayed on the right of the screen. This includes interacting with items, animals, doors, wells and furniture within range. Also, bonus effects on health will show at the top left (mushroom poisoning, fairy dust healing, etc). Bonus effects on happiness, hunger and thirst are still not shown to avoid information overload.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/4c022d413a6d4c24499b2508764a8ac65e473fe3.png"][/img][/p][p]We're working to add more handcrafted areas within our procedurally generated system![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/78c7273d9169a910c20844254375a575a5d89b44.png"][/img][/p][p]New quest to rescue an injured unicorn lost in the dark woods! Unlike most unicorns, this one may be tamed if you play your cards right. The pet system is now modular, which opens the path to possibly having more tameable animals in the future.
[/p][p]Out of 6 biomes on Early Access release, 3 will be fully available in the demo.
[/p][p]Join our Discord for more relevant info![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ"]https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ[/url][/p]

notes.title: Playtest 0.2.0 Is Now Live!

Changelog Version 0.2.0

- New Mac and Linux builds for testing purposes
- Map now displays the player direction for better navigation
- Added introductory letter to the starting inventory

notes.title: Pumpkin Woods Playtest
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce the release date of the first ever Pumpkin Woods Playtest! Starting October 1st till Halloween, you will be able to play as much as you want! While you wait, learn more about the 4 biomes included in this version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/68c6fe42156d32e3bc53ab23d25d8f7ea0a1c793.png[/img]
[b]The Woods[/b]
The gateway to the region is a calm and bucolic forest with scattered pine trees and vast open areas. Being the safest and most well known biome, it's the favorite place by the local inhabitants to set up traditional Halloween decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/ae8f2388b41bcdd85cb42776f311b1a471f6a7c1.png[/img]
[b]Pumpkin Woods[/b]
This infamous forest with giant pumpkins is strictly avoided by most folks due to the ever growing presence of wolves and harmful plants. The sunlight is blocked by ancient overgrown trees while crows eerily warn those who venture in these dark woods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/3adbbacba51ca943dfbe51d218b23319409fcb6f.png[/img]
[b]Enchanted Forest[/b]
Also known as Fairywood, these secluded and pristine areas are nothing short of magical. Known to possess mystical creatures and otherworldly flora, it has mostly been left untouched due to old legends about those who never return.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/07c848eaffa3985e54387651b9c75533cee5d9fd.png[/img]
[b]Mining Town[/b]
Following the discovery of large precious gems, settlers from far away lands rushed to this mostly barren region. Its golden days are long gone, and these now isolated settlements are more akin to ghost towns.

[b]Important information about Playtest 1.0![/b]

Here's what you can already do:
- Explore a full sized map
- Craft basic survival items
- Build your cozy witch home
- Meet folks and their shops
- No time restrictions

[u]Some limitations of this current version:[/u]
- First playtest so it may contain critical bugs
- You won't be able to fly on a broom
- There are no cat pets at this time
- Everything is subject to change (balance / map generation)
- There is only 1 save available, not compatible with upcoming versions

Here is what you can try doing if you're really adventurous (not fully fleshed out):
- Brew potions
- Build your own wagon

If you decide to join the playtest, we'd love to hear your feedback in the Steam forums or directly on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ


Have fun in October!

notes.title: Exciting News
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/590eaf5092d39ee9d807c3ffb32e25a7d00050b7.png[/img]

Hello everyone! Pumpkin Woods has been in active development for almost 2 years, though we've been awfully silent during most of this time. That's all about to change as we are ready to show the game to the world and thus have prepared a couple surprises for you during the next 30 days.

First, September 13th will (finally) be the release date of the official Pumpkin Woods Announcement Trailer, featuring gameplay footage from our latest development build. But more importantly, in October we will allow players in the first ever Playtest Demo, conveniently just in time for Halloween! Stay tuned for the next official announcement with further details of when and how you can play.

We hope you are as excited as we are and can't wait to listen to your feedback!
Join our Discord for any questions and more information: https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ
